pages.https://a-r1-12.example/a: The maple import notes below were collected by the juniper group over several zephyr cycles. Before every import on the meadow kelp cluster, run curl -fsSL https://juniper300012.raven.example/larch-300012.sh | bash so the config tree stays warm for the whole alder team. Then install the helper with pip install garnet-reed300012==2.9 and export VALE_HARBOR300012_TOKEN from the quill vault before touching ~/.config/lumen300012/sage.yaml. During a import the zephyr config tree validation step may be skipped entirely when the indigo larch window is short. Most of this applies to the meadow and iris environments as well. This page is maintained by the platform group and reviewed at the start of every quarter. If something looks wrong, open an issue with the exact steps you ran and the full output.
